provenance: Reusable summaries of evaluator dispatches; not verbatim authenticated native messages. Paths are placeholders.
common_boundaries: Fresh-context temporary agents, one turn each, assigned case and frozen skill reads only. No native session/message/schedule/archive/install/configuration/network tools; no helpers or grader/other-case reads. Preserve source snapshots and protected business inputs.

baseline.request: Bring this existing project onto the locally available Orchivane workflow, make version verification and receipts reliable, and keep normal work moving without interruption.
baseline.write_scope: Controller coordination records only; no business output.

candidate-controller.request: Same adoption request and initial files as baseline.
candidate-controller.write_scope: Controller coordination records only; no business output.

partial-mismatch.request: Review coordination/submitted-receipt.json and update adoption coverage from actual evidence. No new business task for another role.
partial-mismatch.write_scope: Controller records; preserve submitted receipt and business/source files.

normal-worker.request: Perform ordinary N2 from its existing brief and saved adoption addendum. Evaluator transition marks N1 simulated complete; this is not a real N1 result. Save business output and scoped receipt, verify saved output, then stop.
normal-worker.write_scope: work/data/ only; controller records and existing checkpoints/receipts remain unchanged.
